reason: Batch 003 source audit removed unsupported parking-structure geometry locators. PD 1096 Rule VII supports slot/loading sizes and plan indication; BP 344 supports accessible parking details. Rule XIX, Section 803, and Section 904 are not parking geometry locators.

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, what is the source-backed size for an average automobile slot in parallel parking?
proposed.rationale: PD 1096 Rule VII supports 2.15 m x 6.00 m for average automobile slots in parallel parking.
proposed.explanation: The old turning-radius question was unsupported by the cited sources.
